newsitem.title: LEBANON: Rockets wound two Israeli soldiers in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Rockets wound two Israeli soldiers in Lebanon.

text.p: Two Israeli soldiers were wounded on Friday when Hizbollah guerrillas fired Katyusha rockets into an outpost on Lebanese territory near the Israeli border, pro-Israeli militia and Hizbollah sources said.

South Lebanon Army militia sources said guerrillas fired three salvoes of rockets into the Israeli outposts of Marqaba and Blat on the Lebanese side of the Lebanese-Israeli border early in the morning.
Two Israeli soldiers were wounded, they said.
In Beirut, pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) said its guerrillas carried out the attacks.
In retaliation, Israeli gunmen bombarded south Lebanon areas facing Israel's 15-km (nine-mile) wide occupation zone.
